sections.title: How it works
sections.body:
Take an existing drawing without image attachments and create a shareable link. The export function receives drawing elements, settings, and files.

It generates an encryption key, serializes the drawing as JSON, converts that text to bytes, and passes the key into compression.

Assuming preparation and the request succeed, and the response parses with a truthy identifier, the posted payload can become a link.

The app places that identifier and key after the URL’s hash sign.

Once the awaited file-save call also completes, the function returns the shareable URL with no error message.

sections.title: A closer look
sections.body: Using the fragment rather than a query parameter is deliberate: the comment says this keeps the key from being sent to the server.
